about_the_game:
Deep in the heart of the Fairyland forest lies a hidden sanctuary of creativity and wonder—The Merry Fairy. As a cherished guest in Fairy’s enchanted cottage, you’ll step into a world where journaling becomes pure magic. Collect whimsical decorations, adorable doodles, and uplifting quotes to create stunning journal spreads that capture your most magical thoughts.

Gather a delightful collection of stickers, doodles, and decorations to bring your journal to life. Arrange them freely to craft beautiful spreads that reflect your dreams, thoughts, and inspirations. Add your own thoughts with customisable freeform entries, or print your journal spread designs so you can add your handwriting offline.  

Let the soft glow of lanterns, the gentle rustling of leaves, and the soothing and carefully curated melodies of Fairyland transport you to a world of tranquillity. Customize your journaling space with warm candlelight, twinkling fairy lights, and the soft hum of nature’s lullaby.

Draw wisdom from ancient quotes, discover thought-provoking prompts, and receive affirmations that spark creativity and self-discovery. Or have an interesting chat with Fairy's friends, who will visit you as regularly as you wish.

All too often, we seek to escape our own enchanted self and find comfort outside of us. Yet the truth is, The Merry Fairy is a gentle exercise of imagination that you will be able to use anywhere, anytime. The most powerful magic lies deep inside of your very own heart. 

✨ Wishlist now and begin your enchanted journey to discover your magic! ✨
detailed_description:
The Merry Fairy Demo content

The Merry Fairy Demo contains a limited amount of features, decorations and conversations, rich enough to provide an enchanted journaling experience. I update the demo fairly regularly as I want to make sure you have a great journaling experience.

Here is what you can expect:

  • A lovely journal with unlimited pages that you can decorate as you wish

    • The ability to customise your journal entries by changing the font and the colour of your text

    • The ability to place, order and rotate your decorations

  • A Guest Book that contains a variety of decorations such as quotes, doodles, backgrounds, frames, washi tapes, flowers, mushrooms

  • Chose the weather that goes well with your mood

  • Receive a few visits from Fairy's friends

  • Read a few letters from Fairy

  • Discover playful little secrets hidden around on the desk

Enjoy!
